summary: Comprehensive testing of ExplainaPro AI-powered video creation platform. Backend APIs 92% successful, frontend UI fully functional, but project creation API has MongoDB serialization issue preventing complete end-to-end flow.

critical_bugs.issue: MongoDB ObjectId serialization error - 'ObjectId' object is not iterable
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks project saving and editor access after storyboard creation
critical_bugs.details: FastAPI cannot serialize MongoDB ObjectId objects to JSON. Need to convert ObjectId to string before returning.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot complete full workflow due to project save failure
integration_issues.workaround: Editor loads correctly when accessed directly, but shows 'No project loaded'

passed_tests: Landing page loads with all 13 categories
Category selection changes hero text and theme colors
Generate button submits and navigates to /create
AI script generation via Gemini 2.5 Flash works (POST /api/restructure-script)
AI image generation via Gemini Nano Banana works (POST /api/generate-image)
Storyboard displays slides with characters and content correctly
All mocked APIs work (voice, music, SFX)
Dashboard page loads and displays projects
Editor page loads independently and shows correct 'No project loaded' state
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix MongoDB ObjectId serialization in /api/projects endpoint. The backend is trying to return ObjectId objects in JSON responses which FastAPI cannot serialize. Convert all ObjectId fields to strings before returning API responses.

success_percentage.backend: 92% (12/13 tests passed - only project creation fails)
success_percentage.frontend: 95% (All UI components work, only end-to-end flow blocked by backend issue)
success_percentage.integration: 80% (AI generation works, but cannot complete full workflow)
